field.name: keyword
field.description: Tìm trong mã và tên khách

query.text:
DECLARE @Keyword NVARCHAR(64), @CustomerID VARCHAR(16) SELECT @Keyword = ISNULL(a.tu_khoa, ''), @CustomerID = ISNULL(a.ma_kh, '') FROM #filter a
-- Từ khóa tìm đúng chữ: thoát ký tự đại diện của LIKE SELECT @Keyword = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@Keyword, '[', '[[]'), '%', '[%]'), '_', '[_]')
SELECT 'SUCCESS' AS code, '' AS message, 'customers, items' AS tables
SELECT RTRIM(a.ma_kh) AS customerId, a.ten_kh AS customerName, a.dia_chi AS address, RTRIM(a.ma_so_thue) AS taxCode, RTRIM(a.dien_thoai) AS phone, a.e_mail AS email FROM dmkh a WHERE a.status = '1' AND (@CustomerID = '' OR a.ma_kh = @CustomerID) AND (@Keyword = '' OR a.ma_kh LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%' OR a.ten_kh LIKE N'%' + @Keyword + N'%') ORDER BY a.ma_kh SELECT TOP 1 'KH001' AS customerId, ma_vt AS itemId, ten_vt AS itemName FROM dmvt
